newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Office Depot edges higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Office Depot edges higher.

text.p: Office Depot Inc was trading higher after the close Monday, and traders attributed the boost to a statement from the company and Staples Inc that they will fight the Federal Trade Commission's attempt to block their proposed merger, traders said.
"With Office Depot we're seeing a little action," one dealer said. "It's trading up at 14-1/2."
Office Depot had closed at 14, up 1 for the day. Staples closed at 22-5/8, and was trading at that price after hours. During regular trading Monday, Staples shares rose 3/4.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc was up 1-3/4 to 43 in late trading, after releasing financial results that exceeded analysts' expectations. The stock had risen 1-7/8 during regular trading.
Also up after the bell was Motorola Inc, trading at 61-1/8 after closing at 60-1/4. Motorola also released financial resultslate Monday. It had gained half a point during regular trading.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 4,500, while session two volume was 366,945.
